item.title: Cross-Model Void Convergence: GPT-5.2 and Claude Opus 4.6 Deterministic Silence
item.description:
📝 Published March 12, 2026 | Version v1 Preprint Open Cross-Model Semantic Void Convergence Under Embodiment Prompting: Deterministic Silence in GPT-5. The paper demonstrates cross-model replication, token-budget independence, partial adversarial resistance, and boundary expansion under explicit silence permission, while separating semantic embodiment effects from ordinary instruction-following or refusal.
